E0359

`+` can't combine Length with Time

What

`+` can't combine Length with Time

Why

Physical quantities must have compatible dimensions before they can be added, subtracted, or compared

Fix

use matching dimensions, or use `*` or `/` to derive a new dimension

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0359: tests/ui/quantity_dimension_mismatch.stderr.

Error [E0359]: `+` can't combine Length with Time

    |            ^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: physical quantities must have compatible dimensions before they can be added, subtracted, or compared
 Fix: use matching dimensions, or use `*` or `/` to derive a new dimension
